subject: CS tooling renewal: consolidation options & risk mitigation
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: CS tooling renewal tracker & ask

Team —

We have three support/success contracts coming up in Q2: Zendesk (support), Intercom (messaging), Gainsight (CS platform). I put together a lightweight matrix (attached) with renewal dates, current ARR, and basic SLOs. Short ask: can each of you review the matrix and reply with the single biggest risk and a recommended negotiation target by EOD Mon 4/25?

Quick context:
- Zendesk renewal: 2027-07-15, current spend $240k/yr, custom add-ons for enterprise routing.
- Intercom renewal: 2027-06-30, $180k/yr, high usage on chat + bots.
- Gainsight renewal: 2027-07-01, $320k/yr, primary for CSM workflows and health scoring.

My thoughts (short): prefer to avoid ripping anything out mid-Q3. Priority is: reduce unit cost where possible, preserve SLA for enterprise incidents, and avoid any migration ahead of the high-traffic holiday sprint in Q4.

Attached: vendor_renewal_matrix.xlsx

Thanks — please be concrete (numbers and timeline).

—
Dylan Brooks
Head of Customer Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CS tooling renewal tracker & ask

Thanks, Dylan — looked through the matrix. High level: usage is up 28% YoY on Intercom (more chat volume), Zendesk is used primarily for webform/QA routing (lower daily volume but critical for escalations), Gainsight hosts our playbooks and enterprise health scoring.

Biggest risk: losing Gainsight playbooks/health scoring during renewal window will affect 20% of ARR-managed accounts (manual work will blow up). Negotiation target: aim for 10-15% off list for renewal + 12 months of extended onboarding credits (to cover upcoming product changes). If they push, ask for a 6-month bridge contract.

Also: need SOC 2 Type II evidence and confirmation on data retention for chat transcripts (Intercom) — legal flagged retention at 7 years for certain contracts.

—
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CS tooling renewal tracker & ask

Adding a quick risk/opportunity note:

Risks:
- Vendor consolidation could introduce integration work (estimated 6–8 wks) that overlaps with Q4 roadmap pushes.
- Intercom pricing is usage-sensitive; migrating Zendesk tickets into Intercom may spike cost if not batched/cached.

Opportunities:
- We can push for standardized data export templates (one-time) and a 90-day overlap for export verification.
- Procurement leverage: three concurrent renewals gives us leverage for multi-product discounting (request 18%–22% off if we commit to 24 months across at least two vendors).

Recommendation: prioritize Gainsight (no migration) -> attempt to buy down Intercom usage cost via committed volume + throttle rules -> keep Zendesk for enterprise routing but renegotiate enterprise add-ons.

—
Lauren Bishop
Product Operations
Redwood Inference

- 4/25: internal decision on negotiation targets
- Week of 5/3: vendor demo/negotiation calls

2) Needs from the team by 4/25
- Final negotiated targets (percent off, term length, any credits)

3) Attachments: contract_templates.pdf (standard SOW and NDAs). I will own negotiations once we sign off. Procurement will require a PO and updated vendor W-9 if totals go above $50k per vendor.

If everyone signs off, I will schedule vendor calls next week.
